HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP — TERMLY EXAM #2
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Avoiding all community work
   B. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   C. Destroying road signs
   D. Littering in markets

2. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Name the president
   B. Explain symbols used on a map
   C. Replace the compass rose
   D. Measure rainfall only

3. Which statement about Human Developments in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Human Developments in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Human Developments in Africa as rumours only.
   C. Say Human Developments in Africa never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Human Developments in Africa.

4. Which statement about Kenyans Response to Colonialism is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Kenyans Response to Colonialism never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Kenyans Response to Colonialism.
   C. Explain Kenyans Response to Colonialism with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Kenyans Response to Colonialism as rumours only.

5. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Avoid saving forever
   B. Ignore prices in shops
   C. Plan income and spending wisely
   D. Hide all money underground

6. Which statement about Colonial Administration in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Colonial Administration in Africa.
   B. Explain Colonial Administration in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Colonial Administration in Africa as rumours only.
   D. Say Colonial Administration in Africa never happens in Kenya.

7. Which statement about Internal conflicts in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Internal conflicts in Africa as rumours only.

   D. Say Internal conflicts in Africa never happens in Kenya.

8. Which statement about Civilisations in South and Central Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Civilisations in South and Central Africa.
   B. Explain Civilisations in South and Central Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Civilisations in South and Central Africa as rumours only.
   D. Say Civilisations in South and Central Africa never happens in Kenya.

9. Which statement about Public Resources under the Constitution of Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Public Resources under the Constitution of Kenya never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Public Resources under the Constitution of Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Public Resources under the Constitution of Kenya as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Public Resources under the Constitution of Kenya.

10. Which statement about Political developments in independent Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Political developments in independent Africa never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Political developments in independent Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Political developments in independent Africa.
   D. Treat Political developments in independent Africa as rumours only.

11. Which statement about French Revolutions is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say French Revolutions never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing French Revolutions.
   C. Treat French Revolutions as rumours only.
   D. Explain French Revolutions with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

12. Which statement about Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya.
   D. Treat Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya as rumours only.

13. Which statement about National Security is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat National Security as rumours only.
   B. Say National Security never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain National Security with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing National Security.

14. Which statement about Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship.
   B. Say Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship never happens in Kenya.

15. Which statement about Organisation of Kenyan Communities since 19th century is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)

   D. Say Organisation of Kenyan Communities since 19th century never happens in Kenya.

16. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Kisumu
   B. Nakuru
   C. Nairobi
   D. Mombasa

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Human Developments in Africa and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
